passages.context: The complete numbered section was inspected with sections 26 and 28. Gregory exhorts candidates not to reject a lengthy exorcism and places it within immediate preparation for baptism, confession, and reception of grace. This controls one orator's baptismal exhortation, not a recoverable rubric, operational sequence, universal fourth-century practice, composite Cappadocian rite, or modern major exorcism.
